verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented natural-language command interface for Plaid Identity Verification. The no-code Workflow Management editor is a visual configuration tool, not natural-language operation. The Plaid-wide MCP server and llms.txt are agent-integration building blocks that belong to other stories, and nothing shows the product itself accepting natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
